title: HandshakeResponse — Acceptance
description: A signed assertion by a service that it has verified a HandshakeRequest and will execute the requested action under the stated effective scope. See spec §8.3.

request_id.description: References the HandshakeRequest this acceptance is bound to

aud.description: The originating agent's DID — MUST equal iss of the HandshakeRequest

capability.description: Name of the capability granted (after intersection)

constraints.description: Constraints granted (intersection of all delegation constraints + service policy)

effective_scope.description: The effective scope under which the action will execute. May be NARROWER than what was requested if intersection narrowed it.

session_token.description: OPTIONAL. An opaque token the agent MAY present in subsequent warm handshakes within the TTL. See spec §9.2.

session_ttl_seconds.description: OPTIONAL. Session token validity window in seconds.

signature.description: Signature over the JCS-canonicalized form. Signed by the service's key.
